decisions.reason: Naval vessel lighting serves a niche, long-cycle defence market where demand is rising and uncertainty is still resolving, and keeping it listed costs little, so the option is worth holding.
The general interior luminaire went from its own launch page to a mere mention, which shows fading emphasis, but a G2 product-line update is cheap to maintain and its value is not yet disproven.
The microprismatic pendant was promoted as a latest release in 2024, which signals growing commitment while its market prospects are still unfolding.
The marine searchlight has stayed listed while its HMI sibling was dropped, which suggests it is the variant the firm chose to retain in its marine portfolio, and its upkeep costs are low.
